tagline.en_US: Host Git repositories, track issues, and configure CI/CD through a web interface. Uses the embedded database and persists its server data.

description.en_US: OneDev is a self-hosted development platform that combines Git repository hosting, issue tracking, and CI/CD pipelines. It provides a graphical interface to design build workflows, manage dependencies, and debug jobs with a built-in web terminal. Teams can organize tasks using automated Kanban boards, review code with inline annotations, and publish documentation through an integrated wiki.
